sources.title: Embedding physical symmetries into machine-learned reduced plasma physics models via data augmentation
reported_findings: Symmetry-augmented data improved inference of fluid equations and pressure-tensor closures in the studied PIC magnetic-reconnection cases.
The authors report suppression of spurious inertial-frame-dependent correlations.
The authors report improved data efficiency and performance over unaugmented models and selected theoretical closures.
sources.metric_policy: The publisher article is CC-BY-4.0 and cites a Zenodo data record (10.5281/zenodo.15498576). The Zenodo record includes both OSIRIS input decks and Section2_Data.zip (~3.6 GB) for the closure study; Section1 diagnostics (~500 GB) are not included. Pin exact record version, files, hashes, and data license. Do not claim the full fluid-equation dataset is available from this record.
dataset_inventory: input_Section1.2d: OSIRIS PIC input deck; Section 1 diagnostics are ~500 GB and are not included in the record.
input_Section2.2d: OSIRIS PIC input deck for the machine-learned closure dataset.

sources.title: A neural operator closure for Landau damping in electrostatic plasma
reported_findings: FNO closure is trained online inside a differentiable fluid solver using closed-solver trajectories.
The closure uses a trailing window of resolved-moment history and is non-Markovian.
The authors report linear and nonlinear Landau-damping reproduction, interpolation to unseen initial perturbation amplitudes, and stability in independent fluid simulations.
sources.metric_policy: The publisher confirms code and training data are openly available at Zenodo version 1.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22800112). Pin the exact record files, hashes, package versions and record license before reproduction. Preserve the 1D electrostatic regime and online-a-posteriori setup.

sources.title: Machine-learning heat flux closure for multi-moment fluid modeling of nonlinear Landau damping
reported_findings: The authors report a learned heat-flux closure that reproduces linear and nonlinear Landau-damping evolution against their Vlasov references.
sources.metric_policy: The publisher states that the linear and nonlinear Vlasov training datasets are deposited on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14915239). Zenodo record lists two MAT files (~81.9 MB total). Pin exact record version, file checksums and dataset license; article license does not establish dataset license.

sources.title: Data-driven discovery of a heat flux closure for electrostatic plasma phenomena
reported_findings: The abstract reports six sparse-regression terms that together explain more than 95 percent of heat-flux variation in the studied cases.
The paper investigates dependence on thermal speed and growth/damping rate.
sources.metric_policy: The >95 percent figure is source- and task-specific. Do not combine it with FNO rollout metrics or magnetic-reconnection closure results.

sources.title: The machine learning approach to moment closure relations for plasma: a review
reported_findings: Identifies off-diagonal pressure-tensor accuracy, out-of-distribution generalization, stable solver integration and physical consistency as important open challenges.
Discusses symmetry and entropy-production constraints as physical admissibility checks.
Highlights the distinction between offline fit and online deployment.
sources.metric_policy: Review-level synthesis only; do not treat the review as an experimental performance point.
